overall: The AG found the Board violated the law by posting its March 9 meeting notice late and by failing to timely approve minutes, but declined to find an intentional violation and ordered compliance and training.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not post notice of its March 9 meeting at least 48 hours in advance; notice was posted about 27 hours before.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of this meeting at least 48 hours in advance.

allegations.summary: Not alleged in the complaint; the AG found on its own review that minutes of the March 9 and April 13 meetings were not approved in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Board violated the law by failing to timely approve minutes of the March 9 and April 13 meetings.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Board members review the AG's Open Meeting Law Training Video #2 (Meeting Notices) and certify compliance to the AG's office within 30 days of the letter.
remedy_passage: we order the Board members to review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Video #2 (Meeting Notices) and to certify to our office within thirty (30) days of this letter, using the attached form, that it has complied with this order.
